items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: Dave was interviewed in Rochester, NY on January 11, 2012, by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Dave was interviewed in Rochester, NY on January 11, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Alanna Rowe was present and participated briefly in the interview.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m in Rochester, New York talking to Dave Rivello, band leader, composer, arranger. Does that just about cover it?
